note: Illustrative calibration cases for the claim score: evidence profiles for results whose fate is known. Profiles are reconstructed from the public record and approximate (numbers are rounded; where a figure is a bound it is the bound). This is a smoke test and regression guard, not validation that the score predicts truth. Add cases with a basis a reviewer can check; do not tune the score to pass this file alone.

cases.summary: Two independent experiments each reported a new particle at about 5 sigma.
cases.basis: ATLAS Collaboration 2012, Phys. Lett. B 716, 1; CMS Collaboration 2012, Phys. Lett. B 716, 30

evidence.observation: ATLAS excess near 125 GeV at about 5.9 sigma
CMS excess near 125 GeV at about 5 sigma, independent detector and analysis

cases.summary: Eradicating H. pylori cured ulcers in randomized trials, replicating the original observation.
cases.basis: Marshall & Warren 1984, Lancet 1, 1311; Hentschel et al. 1993, N. Engl. J. Med. 328, 308 (n=104)

evidence.observation: randomized trial of eradication versus no eradication on duodenal ulcer relapse
evidence.source: Hentschel et al. 1993, N. Engl. J. Med. 328, 308

cases.summary: Large cohort of British doctors showed a dose-response between smoking and lung cancer deaths; replicated by other cohorts.
cases.basis: Doll & Hill 1954, BMJ 1, 1451 (about 34,000 doctors); Hammond & Horn 1958, JAMA 166, 1294

evidence.observation: prospective cohort of British doctors, lung cancer mortality rising with cigarettes smoked

cases.summary: A gravitational-wave signal seen in two detectors at over 5 sigma; many further events followed.
cases.basis: Abbott et al. 2016, Phys. Rev. Lett. 116, 061102

evidence.observation: coincident signal in two detectors with false-alarm rate below one in 200,000 years
evidence.source: Abbott et al. 2016, Phys. Rev. Lett. 116, 061102

cases.summary: A null result for the aether wind, repeated with improved apparatus for decades.
cases.basis: Michelson & Morley 1887, Am. J. Sci. 34, 333; later repetitions by Morley & Miller and Kennedy & Thorndike

evidence.observation: interferometer fringe shift far below the size expected from an aether wind

cases.summary: Excess heat claimed from palladium electrolysis; most laboratories could not reproduce it.
cases.basis: Fleischmann & Pons 1989, J. Electroanal. Chem. 261, 301; negative replications widely reported in 1989

evidence.observation: excess heat reported in a palladium-deuterium electrolysis cell

cases.summary: A new radiation reported by many observers in one country; a visiting physicist found the effect persisted when the key component was secretly removed.
cases.basis: Blondlot 1903, C. R. Acad. Sci. 136, 735; Wood 1904, Nature 70, 530

evidence.observation: observers reported brighter spark appearance under N-rays

cases.summary: An anomalous form of water reported in tiny capillary samples; later traced to contamination.
cases.basis: Fedyakin & Deryagin reports in the 1960s; contamination shown by Rousseau & Porto 1970, Science 167, 1715

evidence.observation: anomalous physical properties measured in water condensed in fine quartz capillaries

cases.summary: A twelve-child case series linking MMR vaccine to autism; retracted, and large studies found no link.

evidence.observation: case series of twelve children with onset reported after vaccination

cases.summary: Neutrinos timed faster than light at about 6 sigma over thousands of events; traced to a loose fibre-optic cable and clock issue, and contradicted by a second experiment.
cases.basis: OPERA Collaboration 2011, arXiv:1109.4897; ICARUS Collaboration 2012 contradicted it

evidence.observation: neutrino arrival earlier than light-speed expectation over about 15,000 events

cases.summary: A bacterium reported to build DNA with arsenic instead of phosphorus; independent groups could not reproduce it.
cases.basis: Wolfe-Simon et al. 2011, Science 332, 1163; Reaves et al. 2012 and Erb et al. 2012, Science 337, 467 and 342

evidence.observation: growth in arsenate medium with arsenic detected in cell extracts

cases.summary: Nine experiments with over a thousand participants reported precognition at p below 0.05; independent replications found nothing.
cases.basis: Bem 2011, J. Pers. Soc. Psychol. 100, 407; Ritchie, Wiseman & French 2012, PLoS ONE 7, e33423

evidence.observation: participants guessed future random picture positions above chance across nine experiments
